verses.arabicText: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.translation: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺

verses.arabicText: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verses.translation: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”

verses.arabicText: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.translation: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajar
verses.translation: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent

verses.arabicText: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu d-dāʿi ilā shayin-nukur
verses.translation: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying

verses.arabicText: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
verses.transliteration: Khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādum-muntashir
verses.translation: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts

verses.arabicText: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.transliteration: Muh'ṭiʿīna ilā d-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasir
verses.translation: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”

verses.arabicText: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnuw-wa-uz'dujir
verses.translation: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated

verses.arabicText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.translation: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”

verses.arabicText: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
verses.translation: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain

verses.arabicText: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.transliteration: Wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudir
verses.translation: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set

verses.arabicText: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
verses.translation: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails

verses.arabicText: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.translation: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur
verses.translation: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsim-mus'tamirr
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery

verses.arabicText: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
verses.translation: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺

verses.arabicText: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Faqālū abasharam-minnā wāḥidan-nattabiʿuhu innā idhal-lafī ḍalāliw-wasuʿur
verses.translation: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane

verses.arabicText: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
verses.transliteration: A-ul'qiya dh-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashir
verses.translation: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”

verses.arabicText: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.translation: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.transliteration: Innā mur'silū n-nāqati fit'natal-lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir
verses.translation: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience

verses.arabicText: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verses.transliteration: Wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bim-muḥ'taḍar
verses.translation: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”

verses.arabicText: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.translation: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥataw-wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓir
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin-najjaynāhum bisaḥar
verses.translation: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn

verses.arabicText: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.transliteration: Niʿ'matam-min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakar
verses.translation: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur
verses.translation: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.translation: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment

verses.arabicText: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzim-muq'tadir
verses.translation: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful

verses.arabicText: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.transliteration: Akuffārukum khayrum-min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī z-zubur
verses.translation: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verses.translation: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”

verses.arabicText: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.translation: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee

verses.arabicText: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.transliteration: Bali s-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarr
verses.translation: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yus'ḥabūna fī n-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqar
verses.translation: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣar
verses.translation: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.translation: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers

verses.arabicText: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.translation: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign
